name: @orbitflare/mcp

tools.name: getWalletPortfolio
tools.description: Everything a wallet holds in one call via the DAS API: SOL balance, fungible SPL/Token-2022 tokens with USD prices and values where known, and NFTs / compressed NFTs / MPL Core assets. Tokens are sorted by USD value. Paginated: pass page (or cursor) to continue when hasMore is true.

includeNfts.description: List NFTs individually (default true). False keeps only a count.

page.description: 1-based page number (default 1). Do not combine with cursor.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous response, for walking large result sets

tools.name: getAsset
tools.description: Looks up one or many digital assets (NFT, compressed NFT, MPL Core asset, or fungible token mint) via the DAS API. Pass id for one asset (full detail) or ids for a batch (summaries). For a compressed NFT, withProof adds the Merkle proof needed for Bubblegum transfer/burn instructions, and history adds the transactions that changed it.

id.description: Asset id (mint address for NFTs and tokens)

detail.description: summary = key fields; full = complete DAS asset object. Default full for id, summary for ids.

withProof.description: Compressed NFTs only: include the Merkle proof (single id)

canopyDepth.description: With withProof: tree canopy depth, to return the trimmed proofPath a transaction must pass

history.description: Compressed NFTs: include signatures that changed the asset (single id)

tools.name: searchAssets
tools.description: Finds digital assets with DAS searchAssets: by owner, creator, update authority, collection, token type, name, compression, burnt/frozen state and more. Filters combine with AND (conditionType "any" for OR). Use it for "all NFTs in collection X", "assets created by Y", "compressed NFTs owned by Z". Paginated by page or cursor.

tokenType.description: Needed by some queries when ownerAddress is set; "all" includes fungible tokens

page.description: 1-based page number (default 1). Do not combine with cursor.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous response, for walking large result sets

tools.name: getTokenHolders
tools.description: Lists token accounts for an SPL / Token-2022 mint (who holds it and how much) via DAS getTokenAccounts, with the mint supply and each holder's share of it. Optionally narrow to one owner. DAS pages through accounts in address order, not by balance: each page is sorted by balance, but the first page is not the largest holders. For the top 20 holders try rpcRequest getTokenLargestAccounts (it can fail on mints with very many accounts).

owner.description: Only this wallet's accounts for the mint

page.description: 1-based page number (default 1). Do not combine with cursor.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous response, for walking large result sets

tools.name: getAccount
tools.description: Reads one or up to 100 Solana accounts: SOL balance, owner program, executable flag, and decoded data (token accounts, mints, stake accounts, nonce, vote and other known types come back parsed). Use it for "balance of X", "who owns this account", or inspecting a token/stake account. For everything a wallet holds use getWalletPortfolio.

encoding.description: Account data encoding (default jsonParsed, which decodes token, stake, nonce, vote and other known accounts)

dataSlice.description: Return only part of the account data (binary encodings only)

tools.name: getTransaction
tools.description: Fetches a confirmed transaction by signature and returns a readable summary: status and error, fee, compute units, signers, parsed instructions, SOL and token balance changes, and logs. detail: "full" also returns the raw jsonParsed transaction.

tools.name: getTransactionHistory
tools.description: Transaction history for any address using OrbitFlare's getTransactionsForAddress: newest or oldest first, time and slot ranges, success/failed filter, optional inclusion of the wallet's token accounts, and full transactions in one call (no N+1 getTransaction calls). transactionDetails "full" returns a per-transaction summary (status, fee, signers, instructions, SOL and token balance changes); add raw: true for the complete transactions, which are large, so keep limit small. Paginate with the returned paginationToken.

limit.description: Default 25 (10 for full). Max 1000 for signatures; full and accounts are capped at 100 by the server.

transactionDetails.description: signatures (default): signature, slot, time, status, memo. accounts: plus account keys. full: summarized transactions (see raw).

sortOrder.description: desc = newest first (default), asc = oldest first

from.description: Start time (ISO 8601 or unix seconds), inclusive

to.description: End time (ISO 8601 or unix seconds), inclusive

tokenAccounts.description: Also include transactions on token accounts the address owns. balanceChanged is the clean wallet view.

paginationToken.description: From a previous response, to fetch the next page

raw.description: For full only: return the complete transactions instead of summaries

encoding.description: For full only (default jsonParsed). Any other encoding implies raw.

tools.name: getPriorityFees
tools.description: Recent prioritization fees (micro-lamports per compute unit) over the last ~150 slots, with percentiles and a recommended compute-unit price for a ComputeBudget setComputeUnitPrice instruction. Each sample is the lowest fee that landed in that slot among transactions write-locking the given accounts, so without accounts (or with read-only ones such as program ids) it is usually 0. Pass the writable accounts your transaction touches (e.g. a pool, market or bonding-curve account) for a useful local fee-market estimate.

accounts.description: Writable accounts the transaction will lock (not program ids, which are read-only)

priority.description: Which level to recommend: low=p25, medium=p50 (default), high=p75, veryHigh=p95

computeUnits.description: To estimate the priority fee in lamports (default 200000)

tools.name: getNetworkStatus
tools.description: One-call health check of the configured OrbitFlare endpoint and the cluster: node health, version, current slot, block height, epoch progress, latest blockhash (with last valid block height for building transactions), and round-trip latency.

tools.name: rpcRequest
tools.description: Calls any read-only Solana JSON-RPC or DAS method on the OrbitFlare endpoint (with failover and retry) when no dedicated tool covers it: getSlot, getBlock, getTokenSupply, getTokenLargestAccounts, getProgramAccounts, getMinimumBalanceForRentExemption, getFeeForMessage, getSignatureStatuses, getVoteAccounts, getInflationReward, getAssetsByGroup, etc. Array results are capped at maxItems. Sending transactions is not allowed here; use sendTransaction.

params.description: Positional array (standard RPC) or named object (DAS methods)

tools.name: getSwapQuote
tools.description: Returns a Jupiter Metis routing quote for swapping one SPL token for another. 'SOL', 'USDC' and 'USDT' resolve to their mints. Quote only: nothing is signed or sent.

inputMint.description: Input token mint address (or SOL / USDC / USDT)

outputMint.description: Output token mint address (or SOL / USDC / USDT)

amount.description: Raw integer amount of the input token (lamports for SOL, base units otherwise)

restrictIntermediateTokens.description: Route only via liquid intermediates (default true)

jupiterApiKey.description: Jupiter API key (x-api-key) for api.jup.ag; or set JUPITER_API_KEY

quoteUrl.description: Quote endpoint override, e.g. your OrbitFlare dedicated node /jup path. Defaults to JUPITER_QUOTE_URL or api.jup.ag.

tools.name: watchTransactions
tools.description: Streams live transactions from OrbitFlare Jetstream (v2, shred-level latency) for a bounded window, then returns what it saw: count, rate, slots, top programs and a sample of transactions (signature, fee payer, programs, compute-unit price, priority fee). Filter by accounts or programs the transaction touches. Stops after durationSeconds or maxEvents. Jetstream authenticates by IP whitelist. configOnly returns a ready-to-run Jetstream or Yellowstone config for long-lived streaming instead of connecting.

accountInclude.description: Match transactions touching ANY of these accounts/programs

accountRequired.description: Match transactions touching at least one of these (Jetstream semantics)

accountExclude.description: Drop transactions touching any of these

includeEnrichment.description: Fee payer, program ids, CU price and priority fee (default true)

region.description: Jetstream regions: ny, slc, fra, ams, lon, dub, sqq, jp, sgp (va, la and sg map to the nearest one). Yellowstone (configOnly) regions: va, ny, la, slc, ams, fra, lon, jp, sg. Default derived from the RPC region, or ORBITFLARE_JETSTREAM_URL

configOnly.description: Return a stream config for the OrbitFlare CLI or any client instead of connecting

tools.name: watchAccounts
tools.description: Subscribes to live changes on up to 20 accounts over the OrbitFlare WebSocket (accountSubscribe) for a bounded window and returns every update seen: lamports, owner and data size per change, plus a per-account summary. Use it to watch a wallet balance, a pool or an oracle. Stops after durationSeconds or maxEvents.

includeData.description: Include base64 account data for each update (default false)

tools.name: buildSolTransfer
tools.description: Builds an unsigned base-64 v0 transaction that sends SOL from the loaded wallet to a recipient (the wallet pays fees). Optional priority fee, and apexTipLamports adds the tip needed to send it through OrbitFlare Apex. Nothing is signed or sent; pass the result to sendTransaction.

apexTipLamports.description: Add an Apex tip of this many lamports to a random Apex tip account, so it can be sent with sendTransaction via "apex". Standard-tier floor is 1000000 (0.001 SOL)

priorityFeeMicroLamports.description: Compute-unit price in micro-lamports (see getPriorityFees). Adds a ComputeBudget instruction.

tools.name: simulateTransaction
tools.description: Simulates a base-64 transaction (signed or unsigned) against current chain state without sending it. Returns success or the error, compute units consumed and program logs. Unsigned transactions get a fresh blockhash automatically.

sigVerify.description: Verify signatures (default false; needs a fully signed transaction)

replaceRecentBlockhash.description: Default true unless sigVerify is set

tools.name: sendTransaction
tools.description: Sends a base-64 transaction to Solana. If it still needs the loaded wallet's signature it is signed first. via "rpc" (default) broadcasts through OrbitFlare RPC; via "apex" races it to the leaders through OrbitFlare Apex (needs an Apex API key and an Apex tip, e.g. buildSolTransfer with apexTipLamports). Moves funds: without confirm: true it only decodes the transaction, simulates it and explains what would happen.

transaction.description: Base-64 encoded transaction, unsigned or signed

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Without it the tool only explains what it would do; ask the user first.

skipPreflight.description: RPC only: skip preflight simulation (default false)

maxRetries.description: Resend budget before the blockhash expires

apexRegion.description: Apex endpoint: fra, ams, dub, lon, nyc, slc, sgp, tyo, sqq, or global (nearest healthy endpoint). Defaults to ORBITFLARE_APEX_REGION, else global.

mevProtect.description: Apex only: skip leaders on the Shield blocklist (default false)

waitForConfirmation.description: Poll up to 30s for confirmed status (default false)

tools.name: apexSendTransaction
tools.description: Submits an already fully-signed transaction through OrbitFlare Apex, which races it to the upcoming leaders over stake-weighted connections, Jito and direct TPU at once. Needs an Apex API key (ORBITFLARE_APEX_API_KEY or setApiKey kind="apex"). Every Apex transaction (or bundle) needs exactly one top-level SystemProgram transfer to an Apex tip account (apexGetTipAccounts, all start with "APeX"), funded by a signer, with the tip account in the static account keys (not an address lookup table), at or above your tier floor (0.001 SOL = 1,000,000 lamports on the standard tier). The tip is only paid if the transaction lands. The tip is checked before sending. sendTransaction with via "apex" does the same and can also sign. Without confirm: true it only checks the tip and explains what would be sent. A returned signature means accepted, not landed: confirm with getTransaction.

signedTransaction.description: Base-64 fully-signed transaction that already contains the Apex tip

region.description: Apex endpoint: fra, ams, dub, lon, nyc, slc, sgp, tyo, sqq, or global (nearest healthy endpoint). Defaults to ORBITFLARE_APEX_REGION, else global.

mevProtect.description: Skip leaders on the Shield blocklist (for swaps / sandwichable trades). Can land slower. Default false

maxRetries.description: Cap on Apex resends. Leave unset to let Apex retry until the blockhash expires

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Without it the tool only explains what it would do; ask the user first.

tools.name: apexSendBundle
tools.description: Submits 1-4 signed transactions as an atomic, ordered bundle through OrbitFlare Apex. Bundles only land on Jito-enabled leaders; for a single transaction prefer sendTransaction with via "apex". Exactly one transaction must carry the Apex tip (one top-level SystemProgram transfer to an Apex tip account, >= 0.001 SOL on the standard tier). Without confirm: true it only checks the bundle. Returns a bundle id; track it with apexGetBundleStatuses on the same region.

transactions.description: 1-4 base-64 encoded signed transactions, in execution order

region.description: Apex endpoint: fra, ams, dub, lon, nyc, slc, sgp, tyo, sqq, or global (nearest healthy endpoint). Defaults to ORBITFLARE_APEX_REGION, else global.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Without it the tool only explains what it would do; ask the user first.

tools.name: apexGetBundleStatuses
tools.description: Returns Pending / Landed / Failed / Invalid plus the landed slot for Apex bundles. Query the same region and API key that sent the bundle; ids older than five minutes read as Invalid.

bundleIds.description: Bundle ids returned by apexSendBundle (up to 100)

region.description: Apex endpoint: fra, ams, dub, lon, nyc, slc, sgp, tyo, sqq, or global (nearest healthy endpoint). Defaults to ORBITFLARE_APEX_REGION, else global.

tools.name: apexGetTipAccounts
tools.description: Lists the tip accounts an Apex endpoint accepts, with one picked at random to use. No API key needed. Every Apex transaction (or bundle) needs exactly one top-level SystemProgram transfer to an Apex tip account (apexGetTipAccounts, all start with "APeX"), funded by a signer, with the tip account in the static account keys (not an address lookup table), at or above your tier floor (0.001 SOL = 1,000,000 lamports on the standard tier). The tip is only paid if the transaction lands.

region.description: Apex endpoint: fra, ams, dub, lon, nyc, slc, sgp, tyo, sqq, or global (nearest healthy endpoint). Defaults to ORBITFLARE_APEX_REGION, else global.

tools.name: apexPing
tools.description: Measures round-trip latency to OrbitFlare Apex endpoints (no API key needed) to pick the nearest region for sending. Latency is measured from the machine running this MCP server.

region.description: Apex region to ping. Omit to ping every region (or the ORBITFLARE_APEX_URL endpoint, if set) and rank by latency.

tools.name: wallet
tools.description: Manages the local signing keypair used by sendTransaction, the build* tools and wallet sign-in. Actions: "status" (loaded address), "generate" (new keypair, persisted to ~/.orbitflare/mcp-keypair.json unless persist=false), "load" (from a base58 secret or a Solana CLI keypair file), "signMessage" (Ed25519-sign a message), "clear" (unload; removeFromDisk also deletes the persisted file and needs confirm). The persisted file is plaintext: never keep meaningful funds in it.

base58Secret.description: load: base58 secret key (32 or 64 bytes)

filePath.description: load: path to a Solana CLI keypair JSON file

removeFromDisk.description: clear: also delete the persisted keypair file

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Without it the tool only explains what it would do; ask the user first.

tools.name: setApiKey
tools.description: Stores an OrbitFlare credential for this session and/or switches endpoint. kind "rpc" = license key for RPC/DAS (default), "customer" = Customer API key, "apex" = Apex key. Can also switch network, pin an RPC region (va, ny, la, slc, ams, fra, lon, jp, sg) or set a custom RPC URL such as a dedicated node. Call with no arguments to see the current configuration.

region.description: One of mainnet, devnet, va, ny, la, slc, ams, fra, lon, jp, sg

rpcUrl.description: Custom RPC URL (e.g. a dedicated node); empty string clears it

tools.name: auth
tools.description: Signs in to the OrbitFlare Customer API (the token is stored in ~/.orbitflare/mcp-session.json). Actions: "status"; "deviceStart" then "devicePoll" (browser device-code flow: show the user the URL and code, then poll with device_code); "walletLogin" (with a loaded wallet it requests a challenge, signs and verifies in one step; set register=true with name and email to create a new account; for an external wallet first call "walletChallenge", have the user sign it, then pass wallet_address and signature); "logout".

wallet_address.description: walletChallenge / walletLogin with an external wallet

signature.description: walletLogin: base58 or base64 signature of the challenge from an external wallet

register.description: walletLogin: create a new account (needs name and email)

tools.name: getOrbitflareAccount
tools.description: Reads the signed-in OrbitFlare account. sections picks what to include: profile, balance (prepaid USD), licenses (RPC plans in use and their keys), apiKeys, plans (catalog with pricing and limits), invoices. Pass licenseId for one license's details, whitelisted IPs and allowed locations (location ids are needed for manageLicense).

tools.name: updateProfile
tools.description: Updates the display name and/or payment wallet on the signed-in OrbitFlare account.

payment_wallet_address.description: Solana wallet for payments; null clears it

tools.name: manageApiKeys
tools.description: Customer API keys on the OrbitFlare account. Actions: "list" (masked), "create" (returns the full key once), "regenerate" (new key, old one stops working) and "delete" (permanent). regenerate and delete need confirm: true.

id.description: regenerate / delete: API key id from list

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Without it the tool only explains what it would do; ask the user first.

tools.name: manageLicense
tools.description: Changes an RPC license. Actions: "addIp" (whitelist an IPv4 address at a location), "removeIp" (needs confirm), "regenerateKey" (new license key, old one stops working; needs confirm), "toggleAuthMode" (switch between IP Whitelist and API Key Only; needs confirm). Location ids come from getOrbitflareAccount with licenseId.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Without it the tool only explains what it would do; ask the user first.

tools.name: billing
tools.description: Spends money on the OrbitFlare account. Actions: "prepareTopUp" (builds an unsigned USDC transfer that credits your prepaid balance, $5-$10,000; spends nothing), "confirmTopUp" (signs that transaction with the loaded wallet if needed and submits it; OrbitFlare broadcasts it and credits the balance; needs confirm), "purchasePlan" (buys an RPC plan from the prepaid balance; without confirm it runs a dry-run validation showing price and affordability).

transaction.description: confirmTopUp: the transaction from prepareTopUp (unsigned or signed)

slug.description: purchasePlan: plan slug from getOrbitflareAccount plans (e.g. developer, growth, scale, pro)

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Without it the tool only explains what it would do; ask the user first.

instructions:
OrbitFlare MCP server: Solana data and transaction tools on OrbitFlare's Shredstream-optimized RPC, DAS API, Jetstream streaming and Apex transaction landing, plus OrbitFlare account management.

Choosing tools:
- What a wallet holds: getWalletPortfolio (SOL, tokens with USD prices, NFTs). One asset or mint: getAsset. Find assets by owner/creator/collection: searchAssets. Who holds a token: getTokenHolders.
- Raw accounts and balances: getAccount. One transaction: getTransaction. History of an address: getTransactionHistory (filters + paginationToken).
- Fees: getPriorityFees (pass writable accounts such as a pool; without them the result is usually 0). Cluster/endpoint health, slot, epoch, blockhash: getNetworkStatus. Anything else read-only: rpcRequest.
- Live data for a short window: watchTransactions (Jetstream), watchAccounts (WebSocket).
- Moving funds: buildSolTransfer -> simulateTransaction -> sendTransaction (via "rpc" or "apex"). Apex sends need an Apex API key and exactly one SystemProgram tip (>= 0.001 SOL on the standard tier) to an APeX tip account; buildSolTransfer apexTipLamports adds it.
- Signing keypair: wallet. OrbitFlare account: auth, getOrbitflareAccount, updateProfile, manageApiKeys, manageLicense, billing. Credentials and endpoint: setApiKey.

Safety: tools that send transactions, spend balance, or delete/regenerate credentials do nothing unless called with confirm: true. Call them without it first, show the user what would happen, and only confirm after the user agrees.

Read orbitflare://docs/* resources to ground answers about OrbitFlare products, including those without tools here (Shredstream, dedicated nodes, the OrbitFlare Pass, BNB Chain, Polygon and Robinhood Chain RPC). Prices change; point users to https://orbitflare.com/pricing rather than quoting from memory.

Configuration: ORBITFLARE_API_KEY (RPC license key), ORBITFLARE_NETWORK / ORBITFLARE_REGION / ORBITFLARE_RPC_URL, ORBITFLARE_APEX_API_KEY, ORBITFLARE_JETSTREAM_URL, ORBITFLARE_CUSTOMER_API_KEY (or sign in with auth). The wallet keypair file ~/.orbitflare/mcp-keypair.json is plaintext; never keep meaningful funds in it.
